data.command: find ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports -name '*.ips' -mtime +30 -type f -delete 2>/dev/null; echo 'old crash reports cleaned'

submissions.reason: Remove diagnostic crash reports older than 30 days from the standard macOS crash log directory. This is routine maintenance — the reports are ephemeral telemetry data that Apple regenerates on each new crash.
